newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki ends easier in fair but cautious trade.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki ends easier in fair but cautious trade.

text.p: Shares ended slightly lower on Wednesday after struggling to hold on to near-neutral levels, with a softer start on Wall Street pointing the way late in the session, brokers said.
"Tomorrow could be another cautious day, ahead of U.S. employment figures due on Friday," one broker said.

The FOX stock futures index closed down 0.27 percent at 1,062.55, while the all-share HEX ended off 0.26 percent at 3,077.10. Total volume from the day's cautious trading was only fair, at 480 million markka.
The market drew little inspiration from several interim reports published during the session.
Valmet fell 3.60 to end at 90.40, after reporting January-April profits down to 322 million markka from 374 a year ago, which was below the median of analysts' forecasts but within the range.
Trade in Valmet was relatively lively, rising above 40 million markka, making it the second most-traded share.
"Valmet's result was below expectations, but basic sentiment on the company is quite positive," one broker said after Valmet had tested its 90.00 support level.
